name: heitoralthmann/conta-azul-cli
description: CLI PHP/Symfony para as APIs Financeiro, Pessoas, Produtos e Serviços da Conta Azul

suggest.ext-posix: Enables full CLI behavior on Unix-like systems; guarded and unused on Windows.

scripts.format:bin: t=$(mktemp); phpcbf --stdin-path=$PWD/bin/ca.php - < bin/ca > "$t"; if [ -s "$t" ]; then mv "$t" bin/ca; chmod +x bin/ca; else rm -f "$t"; fi
scripts.build:phar: set -e; trap '"${COMPOSER_BINARY:-composer}" install --no-interaction' EXIT HUP INT TERM; tools/install-box.sh; "${COMPOSER_BINARY:-composer}" install --no-dev --no-interaction --classmap-authoritative --optimize-autoloader; php -d phar.readonly=0 build/box.phar compile

scripts-descriptions.lint: Checks coding standards. bin/ca is piped through STDIN under a .php path because PHP_CodeSniffer refuses to lint extensionless files.
scripts-descriptions.format: Applies the coding standard in place, bin/ca included.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Runs PHPStan on src/ (level max, per phpstan.neon) and tests/ (level 6).
scripts-descriptions.docs:generate: Regenerates docs/referencia/, commands.json and llms*.txt from the Console definitions plus docs/_data/commands/*.yaml.
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fails when the generated documentation is out of date, or when a curated note names a command or parameter the CLI no longer has.
scripts-descriptions.build:phar: Builds build/conta-azul-cli.phar. Box is downloaded by tools/install-box.sh because the PHAR needs a --no-dev vendor/, where a require-dev Box would not exist; the trap restores the dev dependencies even when the build fails or is interrupted. phar.readonly is forced off since most php.ini ship it On.
scripts-descriptions.smoke:phar: Runs tools/smoke-test.sh against the built PHAR. Nothing in the PHPUnit suite executes the packaged binary, so this is the only guard on it.
